# device-frontier synthetic fixtures

These are synthetic documents, not device rows. Every JSON object carries the key
synthetic set to true. They are generated by the tool itself and committed only so CI
proves the verdict directions:

    python3 scripts/device-frontier.py --write-fixtures scripts/tests/fixtures/device-frontier

Do not hand-edit them: scripts/tests/test_device_frontier.py regenerates the set in a temp
directory and fails if the committed bytes drift (the manifest row_dir is the only field
rewritten, to keep it relative to this directory).

| case | mode | expected exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| coherent-6-stage-kv_path | probe | 0 |
| coherent-refusal-at-reference_seam | probe | 0 |
| incoherent-18-stage-chain-at-reference_seam | probe | 1 |
| coherent-refusal-at-moe_shared | probe | 0 |
| off-by-one-18-stage-chain-at-moe_shared | probe | 1 |
| degenerate-no-stage-ran-kv_path | probe | 1 |
| rank-different-chain | probe | 1 |
| host-arm-document | probe | 1 |
| missing-rank-document | probe | 2 |
| empty-rank-document | probe | 2 |
| bad-rope-geometry | probe | 1 |
| note-without-not-host-validated | probe | 1 |
| complete-19-stage | complete | 0 |
| require-complete-on-refused-row | complete | 1 |
| completed-frontier-incomplete | complete | 1 |
| complete-without-logits-bins | complete | 2 |

Exit codes: 0 = coherent (a refused probe, or a gate-eligible completed layer), 1 = a finding
(rank disagreement, lost-chain contradiction, host arm, bad geometry, ...), 2 = cannot testify
(missing/unreadable/empty document or missing numerical-gate input) - a stop, never a pass.
